user.title: DTSU666 Sniffer
user.description: sniff = Waveshare channel in transparent mode (protocol None): passively reads the Deye <-> DTSU666 traffic. poll = channel in Modbus TCP mode: the integration asks the meter itself (a second master on the bus).

data.interval: With 'ask for current' on: ask voltage + current every (s)
